freezeRequires: all gates green locally and in CI
no fake success paths (NOT_CONFIGURED used for missing providers)

phases.name: Foundation & Platform Skeleton
phases.goal: Runnable, tested, CI-gated monorepo: api, worker, web shell, db, cache, storage, observability, design tokens.
deliverables: pnpm workspaces + Turborepo + strict TS project refs + ESLint/Prettier + Vitest + Playwright + .env.example + .nvmrc
apps/api: Fastify + Zod type provider, OpenAPI /docs, /health + /ready, request-id/correlation, pino logs, OTel bootstrap, env->Zod config, AppError envelope, graceful shutdown
apps/worker: BullMQ worker bootstrap + heartbeat job
apps/web: Next.js App Router + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + Emerald&Copper tokens, themed shell (TopBar + CopperCard + GlassCard)
packages/core, packages/config, packages/observability, packages/ui (tokens + Monogram/CopperCard/GlassCard/PillButton), packages/db (Prisma: Tenant/User/AuditEvent + migration + seed)
infra/compose: postgres, redis, minio, otel-collector, grafana/tempo
.github/workflows/ci.yml (all gates in order) + security.yml (audit, gitleaks, semgrep)
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/phases/PHASE-01.md
acceptance: pnpm install && docker compose up -d && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm dev starts api+worker+web
GET /health -> 200 with build info; GET /docs serves OpenAPI
web shell renders with design tokens (visual snapshot committed)
all gates pass on a clean clone

phases.name: Core Domain & Data Model
phases.goal: Complete persistent model + domain services with tenant isolation, audit, transactions, structured errors.
deliverables: Prisma models: Tenant, User, Role, Customer, Vehicle, VehicleClass, AvailabilityBlock, Hold, PricingRule, Quote, Booking, Document, Payment, Invoice, Conversation, Message, EscalationCase, AuditEvent, OutboxEvent, IdempotencyKey (+ tenant_id + RLS)
Repositories + domain services (packages/domain) with DI + transaction helper + optimistic versioning
Pricing engine (integer fils, VAT, duration tiers, extras, deposit) with property-based tests
Availability service with holds + TTL release job
Admin REST CRUD (fleet, pricing, customers, bookings) behind authz stub + OpenAPI
Seed: Dubai demo fleet + pricing + demo tenant

phases.name: Event / Workflow Engine
phases.goal: 19-step journey as a typed, persisted, idempotent state machine with retries, timeouts, compensation.
deliverables: packages/workflow: state/transition table, guards, effects, Zod context, version-checked persistence, ESCALATED overlay, resume
Idempotency middleware (HTTP + jobs + webhooks) backed by IdempotencyKey
Transactional outbox -> BullMQ relay + retry policies + delayed timeout jobs
Saga compensation (release hold, void quote, refund intent, notify)
Journey API: start, advance, escalate, resume, cancel + timeline
acceptance: property test: no invalid transition reachable

phases.name: AI Orchestrator & Provider Abstraction
phases.goal: AI drives the journey safely — proposes, never decides.
deliverables: AIProvider interface + anthropic/openai/NotConfigured adapters, env selection, timeouts, retries, cost/latency telemetry
Prompt registry (versioned per step), Zod-validated structured outputs, refusal/low-confidence handling, DLP redaction before provider calls
Step agents: intent, extraction, missing-info, alternatives, quote explanation, on-rental support, follow-up
Tool-calling with permission gates (allowed states + roles); side-effects only via workflow engine
Human escalation service: tiers 2/3/4, reasons, SLA timers, handoff context, resume
AI evaluation harness: golden conversations, recorded fixtures, deterministic offline runs, CI thresholds
acceptance: journey steps 01-08 run e2e with a provider or degrade to NOT_CONFIGURED
injection suite: prompt injection cannot trigger a tool outside its allowed state

phases.name: Channels, Documents, Payments, CRM & Fulfilment
phases.goal: Every external touchpoint behind a clean interface; full 19-step journey runnable.
deliverables: Gateway inbound model; WhatsApp (Meta Cloud API + signature verify), Web chat (REST + SSE), Email (inbound webhook + outbound); templates, rate limits, receipts; NOT_CONFIGURED per adapter
Document pipeline: presigned S3 uploads, MIME/size validation, AV-scan interface, extraction interface, checklist, T2 review queue
PaymentProvider interface + instructions + webhook reconciliation + refunds; NOT_CONFIGURED -> explicit manual path flagged in admin
CRM adapter (internal default), delivery/return coordination (slots, assignment, checklists, photos), invoice PDF, follow-up scheduler
acceptance: full journey 01-19 passes e2e with test doubles inside tests only
production wiring shows real provider status per adapter in admin Settings

phases.name: Security Engine & Zero Trust
phases.goal: Zero-trust layering verified by tests (WAF -> AuthN -> AuthZ -> Tenant -> Sandbox -> Egress -> DB policy -> Encrypted data).
deliverables: Edge: Redis rate limiting + WAF rules (body size, schema, IP lists, bot signals)
AuthN: OIDC/OAuth2, <=15-min access tokens, rotating refresh, step-up/MFA for admin
AuthZ: RBAC + ABAC policy engine (tenant, ownership, journey state, tier) in one middleware and in services
Tenant isolation: RLS on every table, per-connection tenant context, cross-tenant negative tests
AI sandbox: tool permission matrix, egress allowlist, injection defences, output DLP
Data: TLS, field-level PII encryption, secrets management, key rotation runbook
Detection & response: anomaly rules, automatic restricted response, security event stream, T4 escalation
CI: Semgrep, dependency scan, gitleaks, Trivy image scan, ZAP baseline
docs/SECURITY-MODEL.md (STRIDE) + compromised-account kill-chain test
acceptance: kill-chain test proves each layer contains a compromised account
all scanners green with zero critical

phases.name: Admin Dashboard (Web)
phases.goal: Dashboard wireframe, pixel-faithful to the design system.
deliverables: Home: TopBar, JourneyStepper (live counts), StatTiles (Active Bookings, AI Automation %, Human Escalations, Revenue AED)
Bookings, Journeys (live state + timeline), Escalation queue (tiers, SLA), Document review, Customers, Fleet & availability, Pricing, Payments/Invoices, Audit log, Settings (provider status)
Real-time via SSE, role-aware navigation
Playwright e2e + visual regression against reference

phases.name: Customer Mobile App (PWA)
deliverables: Home: Monogram, AI CONCIERGE, Upcoming Rental CopperCard, Documents GlassCard, Payment CopperCard, CONTACT AI
Chat with AI (web channel), Bookings, Document upload with camera, Payments, Profile, BottomTabBar
Installable PWA, offline shell, push-notification interface (NOT_CONFIGURED until keys)
Visual regression against docs/design/reference

phases.name: Observability, AI Evaluation & Automatic QA
phases.goal: Measurable, self-checking system; Automatic QA PASS/FAIL gate.
deliverables: OTel end-to-end (api, worker, web) with journey-id propagation
Metrics: automation rate, escalation rate, step conversion, latency, AI cost; Grafana dashboards in compose
AI evaluation suite (accuracy, safety, hallucination, tone)
Security regression suite + anomaly engine
Automatic QA engine: PASS/FAIL per journey and per release + CI report artifact
acceptance: traces span api->worker->web with journey id
Automatic QA gate blocks release on FAIL
eval + security regression thresholds enforced in CI

phases.name: Infrastructure, CI/CD & Release
deliverables: Terraform (network, Postgres, Redis, object storage, container runtime, secrets, WAF)
dev/staging/prod environments
CI/CD with mandatory gates + manual prod approval
migration strategy, backups/DR drill, runbooks, SLOs/alerts, release-freeze checklist
acceptance: prod deploy gated by all checks + manual approval
